 Legal shifts in Texas and Delaware leave Elon Musk's SpaceX-Tesla merger and Meta's new non-voting share plan better prepared to fend off shareholder lawsuits   —  SpaceX-Tesla merger and Meta's new share class expected to fend off legal challenges after shareholder rights diminished in Delaware and Texas.
